literal: Subtle treatises many even if one learns, yet one's own innate intellect indeed will prevail.
translation: Even if a person studies many subtle and profound treatises, their own innate intellect, shaped by destiny, will ultimately prevail.
modern: ஒருவர் நுட்பமான பல நூல்களைக் கற்றாலும், அவருடைய இயற்கையான அறிவே மேலோங்கி நிற்கும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how destiny influences a person's intellect and behavior. Even if someone acquires vast knowledge by studying highly sophisticated and subtle treatises, their innate understanding ('uṇmai aṟivu') will ultimately dominate. Here, 'uṇmai' refers to the natural, fundamental disposition of the mind as determined by one's destiny. Thus, external learning cannot easily override the core nature ordained by fate.
